_doc: #1722 THE PERFORMANCE PORTFOLIOS of Capital-Stack-FinTerminal: EQ > Performance (ten factor portfolios) and FI (the bond groups). This file is the DECLARATION: which portfolios exist, where their constituents and weights come from (a fund's published holdings, a declared weighting scheme), the benchmarks and the words of the page. The constituents and weights themselves are the RUNTIME dataset `dataset` (repo data/fleet/app/<package>/<dataset>.json, written by scripts/gen-perf-portfolios.py from this file and the publishers' own files, served by the fleet data framework; never an asset of the APK). No price and no performance is declared or stored: every figure is asked of the app's quote source (data/quotes.json `source`) when a page opens.

_doc_bond_proxy: countries.<cc>.bond_proxy: a listed fund of the country's government bonds at the quote source. currency `local` = the fund is priced in the country's own currency (its move is the bond return in local currency); `usd` = priced in US or Hong Kong dollars, unhedged (its move is already the dollar return).
_doc_intended: groups[].intended: the iShares fund(s) the portfolio is meant to follow. Their holdings files are behind the publisher's site-entry page for an automated reader (the CSV endpoint answers with the product page), so the generator reads the State Street fund of the same index or factor (`etf`) and the page prints both; EMLC (VanEck) likewise, EBND stands in.

sovereign._doc: #1727 where a country without a listed bond fund gets its government bond return: the fleet container's sovereign-returns route first (private mesh), else the same arithmetic on the OECD 10-year yields read from DBnomics. Monthly data: it answers the 1M and YTD periods, to its last published month.
sovereign.label: 10-year yield and duration approximation (OECD yields)

sankey._doc: The flow panel: the portfolio into its largest `buckets` buckets (the rest folded), each bucket into the portfolio's `holdings` largest constituents (the rest of a bucket folded).
